subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Should this issue remain the concrete subagent-fanout tracker, or should maintainers explicitly close it into the run-lifecycle umbrella and narrower takeover/typing trackers?
rationale: The source-level bug family is credible, but the remaining work spans open PRs and design-level lifecycle policy that automation should not sequence alone.

options.title: Keep This Concrete Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open until the retained-lock, false-takeover, suspended-delivery, and typing cleanup slices are each landed, rejected, or linked to a canonical narrower item.

options.title: Close Into Lifecycle Umbrella
options.body: Close this issue as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101863 after explicitly noting which narrower issues/PRs preserve the subagent and Telegram-specific evidence.

options.title: Split Remaining Slices
options.body: Create or designate separate canonical trackers for subagent delivery durability and requester typing cleanup, then close this issue once those links exist.

recommendation.title: Keep This Concrete Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the retained-lock, false-takeover, suspended-delivery, and typing cleanup slices are each landed, rejected, or linked to a canonical narrower item.

likelyOwner.reason: The open maintainer-labeled lifecycle umbrella is authored by obviyus and is the most likely place to decide whether this report becomes a satellite or remains a concrete tracker.
